0022600186.text: The Clippers (1-6, 4th in the Pacific and 13th in the West) host the Miami Heat (2-5, 10th in the East) in the eighth game of the 2026-27 season, and Los Angeles enters on a six-game losing streak. The Clippers are 1-2 at home and are currently without Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles surgery), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery), all listed as out. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Clippers lost their 2025-26 season series 0-2, including a 140-123 loss in Miami on December 1, 2025.
